messages.content: Change the settings of my air conditioner. Set it to cool mode with a target temperature of 22 degrees Celsius. Enable the power save mode and set the high wind strength. Start in 1 hour and 30 minutes from now? For everything else

function.name: ThinQ_Connect
function.description: Sends a command to control an appliance, allowing only a single value to be sent in one call. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

body.description: A dictionary containing the parameters for the appliance command.

airConJobMode.description: The current job mode of the air conditioner.

windStrength.description: The strength of the air flow.

monitoringEnabled.description: Whether air quality sensor monitoring is enabled.

airCleanOperationMode.description: The operation mode for the air cleaning function.

airConOperationMode.description: The operation mode for the air conditioner, indicating if it is turned on or off.

powerSaveEnabled.description: Whether power save mode is enabled to conserve energy.

targetTemperature.description: The target temperature to set for the appliance, in degrees Celsius.

relativeHourToStop.description: The number of hours from the current time when the appliance should stop. If set to null, the appliance will not be scheduled to stop.

relativeMinuteToStop.description: The number of minutes from the current time when the appliance should stop. If set to null, the appliance will not be scheduled to stop.

relativeHourToStart.description: The number of hours from the current time when the appliance should start. If set to null, the appliance will not be scheduled to start.

relativeMinuteToStart.description: The number of minutes from the current time when the appliance should start. If set to null, the appliance will not be scheduled to start.

message.reasoning:
The user wants to change settings of their air conditioner. They want to set it to cool mode with a target temperature of 22°C. Enable power save mode and set high wind strength. Start in 1 hour and 30 minutes from now. For everything else, presumably keep defaults or unspecified. We need to call the function ThinQ_Connect with appropriate body. The function expects a dictionary with keys: airConJobMode, windStrength, monitoringEnabled, airCleanOperationMode, airConOperationMode, powerSaveEnabled, targetTemperature, relativeHourToStop, relativeMinuteToStop, relativeHourToStart, relativeMinuteToStart.

We need to set airConJobMode to "COOL". windStrength to "HIGH". powerSaveEnabled to true. targetTemperature to 22. relativeHourToStart to 1. relativeMinuteToStart to 30. For everything else, we can omit or set to defaults. The function likely uses defaults if omitted. So we can just include the keys we want to set. The user didn't mention anything about airConOperationMode; maybe we should set it to "POWER_ON"? But they didn't specify. The default is "POWER_OFF". But if we want to start the AC, we might need to set airConOperationMode to "POWER_ON". But the user didn't explicitly say to turn it on. They said "Start in 1 hour and 30 minutes from now". That implies we want to schedule a start. But we might also need to set airConOperationMode to "POWER_ON" to ensure it's on. But the function might interpret relativeHourToStart as scheduling a start. But if airConOperationMode is "POWER_OFF", maybe it won't start. But the user didn't mention turning it on. But they want to start it. So we should set airConOperationMode to "POWER_ON". The user didn't mention anything about monitoringEnabled, airCleanOperationMode, relativeHourToStop, relativeMinuteToStop. So we can leave them out.

Thus the function call:

ThinQ_Connect({
  body: {
    airConJobMode: "COOL",
    windStrength: "HIGH",
    powerSaveEnabled: true,
    targetTemperature: 22,
    relativeHourToStart: 1,
    relativeMinuteToStart: 30,
    airConOperationMode: "POWER_ON"
  }
})

We need to call the function.
